   Our study provides valuable insights and lays the foun-     mitigate such biases and enhance model generalization.
dation for potential solutions; however, certain limitations
point to avenues for future exploration:                          Overall, our results revealed that the proposed masking
                                                               strategies improve OOD performance, with the early mask-
   Dataset Scope and Pre-trained Models: The research          ing strategy exhibiting the best generalization capability on
study was mainly restricted to the CUB dataset, and we uti-    both CNN and ViT. Early masking is particularly advan-
lized publicly available pre-trained models due to time and    tageous when fine-tuning the model backbones, with late
computational constraints. Expanding our assessment to en-     masking not benefiting from fine-tuning and even loosing
compass larger datasets featuring diverse species and back-    some OOD generalization capacity in the case of ViT. No-
grounds, while also maintaining better control over pre-       tably, a ViT variant employing GAP-Pooled Patch token-
training methodologies, will enhance the generalizability      based classification, combined with early masking, exhibits
and robustness of our conclusions.                             the highest OOD robustness of all tested settings.

   Real-World Robustness: Our reliance on FG-BG                   While our study provides valuable insights and solu-
ground truth annotations during segmentation model train-      tions, certain limitations remind us of unexplored frontiers.
ing may not align with scenarios where such privileged in-     Expanding investigations to larger datasets, controlled pre-
formation is unavailable. Deploying our proposed models        training methodologies, and considering real-world scenar-
on real-world datasets without access to FG-BG annotations     ios lacking FG-BG annotations are essential steps toward
could yield further insights into its robustness.              refining and extending the impact of our methods.

   Computational Overhead: Our proposed masking                   In conclusion, our study emphasizes the significance of
strategies involving the segmentation model introduce com-     considering background information in object-centric tasks
putational overhead, which could be infeasible in scenar-      and demonstrates effective solutions to mitigate biases and
ios with tight time constraints. To this end, future research  enhance model generalization.
could explore techniques that seamlessly integrate back-
